title: Cline
description: AI coding assistant for VS Code, JetBrains, and terminal. Install the extension or CLI, then let Cline write, edit, and run code for you.
notes: Skill installs target Cline by default. Cline can be installed as a VS Code extension or via npm CLI.
The VS Code extension is installed manually from the marketplace; the CLI installs via npm install -g cline.
Cline does not have a standalone plugin marketplace of its own.
